name: Luồng 1 - Ingest, Anti-Spam & Blacklist Quarantine (12 Nodes)

parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(sender_email, email, $1) as sender_email, COALESCE(reputation_score, 100) as reputation_score, COALESCE(failed_attempts, 0) as failed_attempts, COALESCE(is_blocked, false) as is_blocked, COALESCE(status, 'neutral') as status, notes FROM email_senders_reputation WHERE sender_email = $1 OR email = $1 LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO email_quarantine_vault (sender_email, subject, raw_payload, quarantine_reason) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4) RETURNING id;

Payload Normalization Code').first().json), $('3. Filter System Bounces Code').first().json.is_system_bounce ? 'Email hệ thống tự sinh bounce' : 'AI Agent 9 & SOC phát hiện vi phạm bảo mật / blacklist'] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO email_senders_reputation (sender_email, email, reputation_score, failed_attempts, is_blocked, status, notes)
VALUES ($1, $1, 70, 1, false, 'suspicious', 'Vi phạm cách ly bởi AI Agent 9')
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
  failed_attempts = email_senders_reputation.failed_attempts + 1,
  reputation_score = GREATEST(email_senders_reputation.reputation_score - 30, 0),
  is_blocked = CASE WHEN (email_senders_reputation.reputation_score - 30) < 20 THEN true ELSE false END,
  status = CASE WHEN (email_senders_reputation.reputation_score - 30) < 20 THEN 'blacklist' ELSE 'suspicious' END,
  notes = COALESCE(email_senders_reputation.notes, '') || ' [Quarantine strike lúc ' || NOW() || ']',
  last_seen_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO system_audit_logs (source, event_type, workflow_id, description, payload, payload_snapshot) VALUES ('m1-flow1', 'INBOUND_CLEAN_EMAIL_ACCEPTED', 'flow01_ingest_antispam', 'Email hợp lệ đã vượt qua kiểm tra an ninh và AI Agent 9', $1::jsonb, $1::jsonb);
